sections.title: When to use Dead Letter Queue
sections.question: Should I configure a dead-letter queue?
conditions: Target is in a private network or behind a firewall
Need to inspect failed delivery attempts
Need to replay failed events after root cause resolution
no_dlq_when: Need guaranteed delivery without manual intervention
Transient failures are rare and recoverable

sections.title: When to use Replay vs Retry
sections.question: Should I use replay or automatic retry?
retry_when: Network blip or temporary service restart
Transient error that can be automatically recovered
replay_when: Data loss from source (need to resend)
Need to replay historical events for reprocessing
sections.both_used_together: System uses both - retry for transient failures, replay for recovery after diagnosis

sections.title: When to use Deduplication vs Idempotency
sections.question: Should I enable system-level deduplication or consumer-side idempotency?
deduplication_when: Want to prevent duplicate delivery to the same destination
Need to save bandwidth and processing for duplicate events
Managing high volumes of duplicate events from sources
idempotency_when: Need to handle at-least-once delivery guarantees
Need to safely handle retry events on the consumer side
sections.both_used_together: Use both - deduplication to prevent duplicate delivery, idempotency to handle any duplicates that arrive

sections.title: How to choose delivery modes
sections.question: Which delivery mode should I use?
mode_a_when: Target has a public endpoint (even behind load balancer)
mode_b_when: Target is private but reachable from Zen Mesh data plane (same VPC, VPN, WireGuard)
Need mTLS encryption between ingester and egress
mode_c_when: Target is behind NAT or firewall with no inbound access
Target cannot be reached from outside cluster

sections.title: How to configure routing and fan-out
sections.question: How should I route events to destinations?
sections.single_destination: Use simple filtering or routing conditions. Fan-out is overkill.
sections.multi_destination: Use DeliveryFlow CRD with multiple output destinations. Configure per-destination policies for retry, timeout, and DLQ.
sections.conditional_routing: Use JSONPath routing for complex filtering based on event content.
fan_out_when: Single event needs to reach multiple consumers independently
fan_out_not_when: All consumers need the same policy

sections.title: When to use JSONPath routing
sections.question: Should I use JSONPath-based routing?
use_when: Need to route based on event content (not just metadata)
Need to support multiple event types with different routing
not_use_when: Need code execution or custom logic

sections.title: When to use JSONPath transforms
sections.question: Should I use JSONPath transforms?
use_when: Need to normalize payloads from multiple providers
Need to reshape event structure for downstream consumers
Need to add provider metadata or tags
